name: Stratos Meridian Varsity
description:
Stratos is a mid-tier sportswear and lifestyle brand that sponsors several of GLMZ's professional athletic teams and semi-pro leagues. The Meridian Varsity is their flagship fan and player jacket — a classic varsity silhouette in boiled wool body with leather sleeves, ribbed knit collar, cuffs, and waistband, and snap-button front closure. The chest carries a large chenille patch of the wearer's affiliated team or district; the back is either blank or carries a name and number. Custom versions are available through Stratos retail kiosks at a modest upcharge.

This jacket crosses tiers in a way few garments do. Tier 1 kids save up for the cheapest version — wool-analog with synthetic sleeves, Φ45 at a grey-market kiosk. Tier 3 fans buy the genuine article. A Tier 4 exec might have a custom bespoke version made as a gift for their team after a playoff win. The varsity jacket is democratic in aspiration even if not in price. It says something about where you are from and what you belong to.
materials: boiled wool body (wool-analog in budget versions)
ribbed knit collar, cuffs, and waistband
what_it_says: You are from somewhere and you want people to know. You belong to something — a team, a district, a community — and the jacket is the proof.
story_hooks: A specific district's varsity jacket has been adopted as colors by a Shelf crew — wearing it in the wrong neighborhood has become dangerous in ways that have nothing to do with sports
A character is given a varsity jacket with a name and number that belongs to someone who died; the person who gave it to them wants that name to be seen in public
A limited run of Stratos Meridian Varsity jackets was made for a team that disbanded after a scandal; those jackets are now rare, sought-after, and complicated to wear
